seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Cursor position

    if n['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"Cursor: {n['boundary']}")

# Diamond outline pixels (red pixels not at known dot positions)
diamond_pixels = []
dot_positions = {(3, 21), (9, 27), (12, 12)}
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] == 1:
        pos = tuple(n['boundary'][0])
        if pos not in dot_positions:
            diamond_pixels.append(pos)

if diamond_pixels:
    rows = [p[0] for p in diamond_pixels]
    cols = [p[1] for p in diamond_pixels]
    center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"Diamond center: ({center_r}, {center_c})")
    print(f"Diamond row range: {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col range: {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try moving diamond DOWN 2, RIGHT 2 to get center near (10, 27)
# This should put col 27 on same column as red dot (9, 27)
action(['DOWN', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])
</parameter>
</function>
